notes: Each valid vector holds every log the source emitted for its task from the descriptor's fromBlock, as read from the chain, and the record a writer builds from them with the head given.

A log's data is cut to its head words, one per non-indexed parameter, which is all a record reads; dataHash is keccak256 of the full data. Briefs travel inline in Posted and would otherwise add up to 24 KB a log.
The head fields are inputs to the writer. Mainnet agent ids are the ERC-8004 agents BrainChain binds these workers to on Robinhood Chain; testnet agent ids are illustrative.

Every task here was posted, evaluated and recorded by BrainChain itself, and the writer key in the mainnet heads is the client of mainnet task 50. Disputes and appeals have happened only on BrainChain testnet so far.

node cli.mjs vectors --verify 274663=https://rpc.usebrainchain.com --verify 274630=https://rpc.testnet.usebrainchain.com re-reads every log from the chain and checks the transfers. The invalid cases run in test.mjs.
